summary: Dive Into a Hilarious Hidden-Object Adventure!
description:
Curious about how aliens view our world? Looking for Aliens takes you on an unforgettable journey where you uncover the strange, funny, and sometimes absurd truth about life on Earth—all through extraterrestrial eyes. Explore colorful scenes packed with surprises, humor, and easy puzzles in this hidden-object game.
From secret alien outposts to bustling human cities, each level invites you to explore a world where nothing is quite as it seems. With over 25 hand-drawn locations and hundreds of quirky objects to find, the game’s colorful art style and creative settings will keep you hooked for hours.

Explore each scene at your own pace, hunting for objects and uncovering hidden surprises. Need help? Use the built-in hints system to keep moving without losing the thrill of discovery.

Key Features

• Interactive Gameplay: Dive into richly animated scenes where every tap unveils a surprise or a fun detail.
• Lighthearted Humor: Laugh along with clever insights into how aliens might interpret Earth’s oddities.
• Beautiful Artwork: Lose yourself in bright, intricate visuals designed to captivate players of all ages.
• Accessible Design: Whether you’re a beginner or a hidden-object pro, the game’s intuitive controls and flexible difficulty settings make it easy to enjoy.
• Plenty of Extras: Beyond the main objectives, there are side quests and scattered surprises waiting to be discovered.
Over 250 unique items to find in diverse locations.
A mix of challenging puzzles and lighthearted gameplay.
25 hand-drawn locations
Perfect for all kind of players

Embark on a journey like no other, filled with laughs, surprises, and endless fun. Download Looking for Aliens now and discover why this quirky hidden-object game is out of this world!

Looking for Aliens was developed by Yustas Game Studio.
